purpose: One identity-preserving Brooktail hero-art alternative after two sub-0.5 Riverwatch visual rounds; production model remains installed and candidate is OFF.
reference_author: OpenAI imagegen, inspected by Fights lane 2026-10-15
reference_prompt: Edit the supplied Brooktail character reference into a production-ready single-character image-to-3D reference for Tetherbound. Preserve this exact creature's identity: a compact semi-aquatic river otter with chocolate-brown fur, warm cream muzzle/throat/chest, large bright blue eyes, small round ears, pale whiskers, low strong four-legged stance, webbed feet, and one broad flat scaled paddle tail. Strengthen the silhouette for a named water captain encounter by making the head, shoulders, chest and paddle tail clear at gameplay distance, while remaining friendly and clever rather than aggressive. Full body entirely visible in a clean three-quarter left view at neutral standing pose suitable for sculpting; tail must be completely visible and distinctly wide, flat and scaled. Stylized PBR game character concept with cohesive large color masses, restrained tactile fur detail, no armor, clothing, props, pedestal, writing, extra limbs, or other creatures. Isolated on transparent background with even studio lighting, no cast shadow. Keep proportions compatible with a creature whose head reaches just above a 1.80 m trainer after scene scaling.
reference_inspection: Identity, brown/cream palette, blue eyes and broad scaled paddle tail retained. Alpha channel is present. Webbing on the feet is weak and must be checked in the mesh; no production integration is authorized from this reference alone.
required_checks: inspect preview mesh and identity before refinement
measure against 1.80 m trainer; grow smaller subject if needed
retain existing Brooktail rig/animation and production model until an in-world Medium/High comparison and three code-blind judges pass
